title: Equipment and Furnishings — Cargo Compartments — Installation of Impact Resistant Lining Panels

issue.reason: Initial issue of the impact resistant cargo lining panel conversion bulletin.

abstract: Conversion of a cargo compartment to the impact resistant lining panel set with the light strip carried inside the panel, offered per compartment because a mixed set is not permitted.

sections.planning_reason: Cargo lining panel replacement is the highest volume cabin spares line on the type. Panels crack at the lower edge where baggage is dragged across the sill and the surface-mounted light strip is knocked off its clips. Operators flying five or more sectors a day replace an average of 3.1 panels per aircraft per year against a fleet average of 0.9. Two operators asked for a design answer rather than a spares discount, and the panel set introduced in production answers it.
sections.description: The lower cargo lining panels are replaced by items moulded in a glass-reinforced compound with a thicker lower edge and a rolled return, and the compartment light strip is re-housed inside a recess in the panel rather than on clips above it.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Empty the compartment and remove the cargo nets and the loading rail covers. Disconnect the light strip and remove the existing lining panels and their clips from the compartment being converted, zones 111 for the forward compartment or 131 and 141 for the aft. Do a detailed visual inspection of the frame brackets and of the exposed lower shell, and confirm that the aircraft is at the corrosion-resistant doubler standard before the panels are closed up. Install the panel D2550118547929 at each position using anchor nuts EN513769-76 into the existing frame brackets; do not drill structure. Fit the light assembly D2550118482429 into the panel recess and connect it behind the panel. Check that the lens is flush with the panel face at every position. Do the cargo compartment lighting check and the smoke detection functional check. Refit the loading rail covers and the cargo nets and record the embodiment per compartment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to CIRRANE-13 aircraft MSN C00001 through C00675 that are pre modification standard, embodied and recorded per compartment. Aircraft delivered from MSN C00678 onward carry the panels from build. The CIRRANE-11 uses a different panel set and is not covered. A compartment must be converted as a complete set because the new panels have no separate light clips.
sections.material_note: Kit K2550-1018-01 is supplied per compartment and contains the panel set, the light assemblies and the anchor nuts. Lead time is twelve weeks. Removed panels are not returned and may be scrapped locally.

type_data.compliance_time: At the operator's discretion, per compartment.

title: Equipment and Furnishings — Cargo Compartments — Installation of Impact Resistant Lining Panels

issue.reason: Embodiment held and a concurrency statement added, because a compartment converted now may have to be opened again for the detector change in pre-analysis.

abstract: Conversion of a cargo compartment to the impact resistant lining panel set with the light strip carried inside the panel, offered per compartment and currently held pending the aft compartment smoke detector decision.

sections.accomplishment_summary: Empty the compartment and remove the cargo nets and the loading rail covers. Aircraft delivered from MSN C00678 onward carry the panels from build. The CIRRANE-11 uses a different panel set and is not covered. A compartment must be converted as a complete set because the new panels have no separate light clips. Embodiment on the aft compartment is held with effect from the date of this revision. A dual wavelength smoke detector for the aft hold is in pre-analysis and its body is 18 mm longer than the current unit, on the same ceiling line the moulded panel occupies; a compartment converted before that decision is taken may have to be opened again and the moulded panel scrapped, because a moulded panel cannot be cut and no repair scheme covers it. Where both are wanted, the detector goes in first or the two are done in one visit. The forward compartment is unaffected and may be converted at any time. The hold is lifted once the detector proposal is launched or dropped.
sections.material_note: Kit K2550-1018-01 is supplied per compartment and contains the panel set, the light assemblies and the anchor nuts. Lead time is twelve weeks. Aft compartment kits are not released while the hold is in force; order forward compartment kits normally. Removed panels are not returned and may be scrapped locally.

type_data.compliance_time: At the operator's discretion for the forward compartment. Held for the aft compartment until the effectivity is re-stated.

revision_history.reason: Aft compartment embodiment held; concurrency statement with the dual wavelength detector pre-analysis added to the effectivity and material information
